profile.headline: Software Developer II
profile.summary: Software Engineer with 5 years of experience making games and simulations primarily in Unity, Unreal, and different flavors of javascript. I specialize in gameplay systems, UI/UX, and networking, with projects ranging from top-rated consumer releases to government contracts. Outside of work, I explore how games can reflect culture and community — from Grocery Run, a satirical look at Black representation, to Five Mics, a hip hop–themed trading card game. I focus on bridging technical depth with creative vision to deliver experiences that resonate with players.

positions.title: Software Developer II
positions.locationName: Charleston, South Carolina, United States · On-site
positions.description:
Develop and implement gameplay systems for interactive, gamified training products

Build and integrate UI, media, and functional components using test-driven development

Create and maintain scripts and custom tools to streamline production and testing workflows

Debug and optimize game assets to improve performance and stability

Collaborate with cross-disciplinary teams to define system requirements and interfaces

Balance team collaboration with independent task ownership in a fast-paced development environment
positions.insights: Skills: C# · Unity3D · Mixed Reality · WPF Development · WinForms · Government Contracting

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Lead engineer on a 4-person team, responsible for client, server, and tool systems in a hybrid digital/physical collectible card game.

Built a card creator tool using Unity UI Toolkit and Scriptable Objects, empowering designers to implement abilities without code.

Deployed a server-hosted multiplayer prototype using FishNet net code as our server-authoritative networking solution.

Supported a successful independent crowdfunding campaign raising $17K from over 160 unique backers in 1 month.
positions.insights: Skills: Unity3D · C# · Unix · Docker · JavaScript · Remote Procedure Call (RPC) · Software Infrastructure · Server Architecture · Game Development · Shopify

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed key gameplay features including a penalty drop system, in-game tournaments, and a social service for friend interactions within the GOLF+ VR experience.

Integrated backend API services for critical game functions like user data, match data, and leaderboard management, ensuring seamless data flow and storage for live service gameplay.

Collaborated on live service releases, quickly addressing and resolving player-reported issues across physics, network, graphics, UI, and performance to ensure game stability during frequent patch updates.

Enhanced game analytics by integrating an auxiliary analytics service API, providing deeper insights into player behavior and system performance for data-driven improvements.

Led cross-functional debugging efforts, resolving critical bugs under tight deadlines to maintain a smooth user experience for live service players.
positions.insights: Skills: Virtual Reality (VR) · Unity3D · C# · React.js · Augmented Reality (AR) · Game Programming

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Developed and maintained digital slot machine games in Unity and Godot, including porting legacy titles between engines for improved performance and consistency. Collaborated with designers and artists to implement gameplay logic, UI, and animations for a polished player experience.

positions.title: Level Upstate - Game Programmer
positions.description: Main programmer as a part of student-based team NO! studios. The team entered the 8 week program, Level Upstate, where we made weekly rapid prototypes and learned what it means to develop an independent game studio.

positions.title: Admissions Ambassador
positions.description: As an Admissions Ambassador at Rensselaer Polytechnic Institute, I give potential students and families tours of the university, answering questions they might have or directing them to the appropriate counseling/department for help.

positions.title: Undergraduate Research Assistant
positions.description: Research under Dr. Wayne Gray and Dr. Michael Lynch within the Cognitive Science department at Rensselaer Polytechnic Institute. Research involves making a "Joint Action" game to be used for data collection and research purposes for other practitioners in the Cognitive Science field.

positions.title: Instructor
positions.description: Teach local high school kids how to program on Saturday mornings.

positions.title: Instructor
positions.description: Taught and counseled 300+ kids ranging from 5-18 how to code in python and c++ over the course of 9 weeks. Different sets of kids would come to either commute or sleep over at Emory's campus each week, with our final goal being a project that showed what they cumulatively learned that week.

positions.title: Pre-College Initiative Chair
positions.description: Mentored high school kids that attended Troy High School with different programs we host each week. Those programs usually tackled subjects about transitioning from high school to college, as we wanted to prepare them as much as we could for higher learning.

honors.title: RPI GameFest 2021 Impact Award
honors.description: Won the Impact award at RPI's annual GameFest award for my solo developed game, Grocery Run. The game itself was made as an auxiliary project to my Master's Thesis where I intended to question if African American representation could exist through satire and cultural humor in video games.
honors.issuer: Issued by Rensselaer Polytechnic Institute · May 2021

honors.title: RPI GameFest 2020 Technical Excellence Award
honors.description: Won the Technical Excellence Award at RPI's annual GameFest event. The game, Pandora's Box, is a Mixed Reality escape room game built at RPI's Emergent Reality Lab, which takes advantage of 3D rear projection and a VICON tracking system. In a team of 5, I primarily served as designer, while also helping with programming and other physical/technical tasks. Pandora's box was also selected by RPI to be presented at the 2020 Game Developers Conference, but unfortunately wasn't able to make it due to COVID protocols.
honors.issuer: Issued by Rensselaer Polytechnic Institute · May 2020
